scripts.db:dev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let c=fs.readFileSync('.env','utf8'); c=c.replace(/NEXT_PUBLIC_DB_ENV=.*/, 'NEXT_PUBLIC_DB_ENV=dev'); fs.writeFileSync('.env',c); console.log('Switched active database to DEV (testing)');"
scripts.db:prod: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let c=fs.readFileSync('.env','utf8'); c=c.replace(/NEXT_PUBLIC_DB_ENV=.*/, 'NEXT_PUBLIC_DB_ENV=prod'); fs.writeFileSync('.env',c); console.log('Switched active database to PROD (real data)');"
